mapper.sql: datasource_id, name, db_type, host, port, database_name, schema_name, jdbc_url, username, password_enc, sample_limit
mapper.update: update ontology_proposal set status = #{status}, review_by = #{username}, review_time = now(), review_comment = #{comment}, update_by = #{username}, update_time = now() where proposal_id = #{proposalId} and status = #{draft}
mapper.select: select proposal_id, proposal_name, config_json from ontology_proposal where task_id = #{taskId} and proposal_id < #{proposalId} order by proposal_id desc limit 1
select proposal_id from ontology_proposal where task_id = #{taskId} order by proposal_id desc limit 1
select proposal_id, config_json from ontology_proposal where task_id = #{taskId} order by proposal_id desc limit 1

select t.task_id, t.summary, p.proposal_id, p.config_json from analysis_task t left join ontology_proposal p on p.proposal_id = ( select p2.proposal_id from ontology_proposal p2 where p2.task_id = t.task_id order by p2.proposal_id desc limit 1 ) where t.task_id = #{taskId}
select count(*) from ontology_proposal where proposal_id = #{proposalId} and task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.insert: insert into ontology_proposal (proposal_name, proposal_type, task_id, config_json, status, create_by, create_time) values (#{proposalName}, 'ONTOLOGY_BUNDLE', #{taskId}, #{configJson}, 'DRAFT', #{username}, now())
mapper.select: select d.name, d.schema_name, d.db_type from analysis_task t left join ontology_datasource d on d.datasource_id = t.source_id where t.task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.insert: insert into ontology_import_record (proposal_id, target_system, status, detail, create_by, create_time) values (#{proposalId}, #{targetSystem}, #{status}, #{detail}, #{username}, now())
